summary: Converts POP point, vertex, or primitive attributes into CHOP channels, with naming, thinning, type-suffix, and group controls for large geometry datasets.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable POP attribute download and conversion

key_params.name: typesuffix
key_params.note: Append data-type suffixes to preserve attribute type information

key_concepts: one POP point as one CHOP sample
thin out by range, step, or random selection
Basic and Precise channel name formats
Type Suffix for POP data-type preservation

common_gotchas: This operation downloads GPU data to CHOPs; large POPs can become expensive quickly.
Precise naming and Type Suffix help avoid collisions when attributes have multiple components or types.
Group and thinning settings are important when converting dense point clouds.
